cache_ttl_seconds.title: Cache TTL (seconds)
cache_ttl_seconds.description:
Seconds a cached artifact stays valid. `0` keeps it forever.

Nothing expired before this existed: once a file had been fetched it was served from
storage for good, so a corrected upstream artifact or a moved snapshot never arrived.

mutable_ttl_seconds.title: Metadata and snapshot TTL (seconds)
mutable_ttl_seconds.description: Seconds a cached `maven-metadata.xml` or snapshot build stays valid.

priority.description: If Null then it will be the lowest priority

username.title: Username
username.description: Username for an upstream that requires authentication.

password.title: Password
password.description: Password or token for an upstream that requires authentication.
